messages.subject: Stratified Density Estimates
parts:
Folks,
=20
I am combining two density estimates (not replicates; all components=20
estimated independently) using the method outlined in section 3.7.1 in=20=

Buckland et al. 2001. I am weighting the stratified estimate by effort=20=

instead of area per instructions on page 214 in the UGD 5.0 Beta 5. I'm=20=

most interested in the case where one of the density estimates is =3D 0.=20=
=20
The weighted mean density works out fine. However, the variance =3D 0 an=
d=20
df =3D 0 (for the zero mean case) produces divide-by-zero errors in the=20=

denominator of the Satterthwaite approximation of df for the stratified=20=

estimate. Is it legitimate to simply drop those terms from the equation=20=

on pg. 90 in Buckland et al. 2001)?
=20
Thanks in advance,
=20
Brian Underwood
